theorems.label: ds-treewidth
theorems.statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides Dominating Set within the stated running time. f(k) 2^(o_eff(t)) B^(O(1)). The graph is connected and bipartite. The prefactor f is any total computable positive integer-valued function of the solution budget k. The exponent h is computable and nonnegative integer-valued. There is a computable function T such that h(t) ≤ η max(t, 1) whenever t ≥ T(η), for each positive rational η.

reviews.scope: Checks Lin’s compact Set Cover interface, the connected bipartite graph, budget k, intrinsic width bound and the effective deterministic running-time transfer.

recoveryAssessments.comparison: Taking f=1 reaches the historical treewidth exponent scale for computable effectively sublinear exponents. The exclusion holds on connected bipartite graphs and allows a computable prefactor in the solution budget.
